Prior to each Round , each Competitor that is intending to enter an Automobile in the Event must lodge a completed Entry Confirmation Form with the CM prior to the specified Entry closing date detailed in the Supplementary Regulations for the Event .

A maximum of twenty-eight (28) entries (excluding Guest Drivers ) will be accepted for each Round by the CM in its sole and absolute discretion without providing any reasons.

Entry acceptance preference will be given by the CM to Championship Registered Drivers .

If the number of entries received for a Round exceed twenty-eight (28) (excluding Guest Drivers ), the CM reserves the right to accept or refuse an Entry for a Casually Registered Driver at its sole discretion without providing any reasons.

A Competitor will only be considered as being entered for a Round following:

Lodgement of a completed Entry Confirmation Form before to the specified Entry closing date;

Payment of the applicable Entry Fee as detailed in the Commercial Agreement, and;

Receipt of written notification from the CM that their Entry has been accepted.

Notwithstanding the Code , the NCR , these regulations, the CRSR, and any Supplementary Regulations , the CM reserves the right to accept or refuse an Entry from any Competitor and/or Driver in its sole and absolute discretion without providing any reasons. There is no automatic entitlement or acceptance of participation in the Championship.

Scrutineering at each Round will be conducted in accordance with the Motorsport Australia Targeted Scrutiny system.

Each Automobile must be presented for scrutineering at the appropriate times, in a complete and finished state and in 'ready to race' condition , including all markings and Seals on the Automobile in accordance with these regulations, associated Technical Appendix, Schedule K of the Manual , and the Commercial Agreement.

Each Automobile or part thereof may be inspected by the TD or their nominee at any time during a Round .

The TD reserves the right to take fluid samples from an Automobile at any time during a Round .

Each Competitor and Driver must follow all instructions issued by the TD or their nominee during the scrutineering process.

The TD reserves the right to seal any Automobile or component thereof for further examination at a later date, including after the completion of a Round . All costs associated with the further examination must be borne by the Competitor .

Unless otherwise approved by the TD , it is prohibited to remove any scrutineering sticker or marking applied to an Automobile by the TD or their nominee.

If a Seal, sticker or marking becomes illegible or is damage during a Track session, the Competitor must notify the TD immediately.

NOTE: The presentation of an Automobile for participation in any Round will be deemed to be an implicit statement by the Competitor of conformity with respect to the eligibility of the Automobile.

The grid for Race 2 at each Round will be determined by each Driver's second fastest time achieved in qualifying, in order from the fastest to the slowest.

For all Sprint Round Formats, the grid for Race 3 will be determined by each Driver's outright Championship points tally from Race 1 and Race 2 in order of highest to lowest. If two or more Drivers have an equal points total, their grid position will be determined be each Driver's fastest qualifying time in order from the fastest to the slowest.

Unless otherwise approved by the Stewards in exceptional circumstances, any Driver whose best time achieved in qualifying exceeds 109% of the time achieved by the fastest Driver in that session, will be prohibited from competing in the remainder of the Round .
